definition: הֲדֹם noun masculine stool, footstool , always joined with רַגְלַיִם ; only in poetry and late writings, (properly something cast down, low ) — ׳ ה absolute Ps 110:1 (or construct before לְ , compare Ges «GKC:130»§ 130 , 1); construct Lam 2:1 + 4t. — footstool , never literal, usually of ׳ י Isa 66:1 רַגְלַי ׳ הַשָּׁמַיִם כִּסְאִי וְהָאָרֶץ ה ; elsewhere with reference to sanctuary רַגְלָיו ׳ ה (compare מְקוֺם רַגְלַי Isa 60:13 ) Lam 2:1 , or perhaps of ark (as place on which God rests) Ps 99:5 ; Ps 132:7 , רַגְלֵי ׳ וְלַה ׳ בֵּית מְנוּחָה לַאֲרוֺן בְּרִיתיֿ אֱלֹהֵינוּ 1Chr 28:2 of conquest of enemies of Messianic king by Yahweh's agency אָשִׁית אֹיְבֶיךָ הֲדֹם לְרַגְלֶיךָ Ps 110:1 .
